content:
**WO-2026-00105 – Motor Controller Housing Blank** (20 pcs, make-to-stock, no sales order linked). Planned 2026-08-15 → 2026-08-21; today is 2026-10-01, so it is **41 days past due** with **0 of 20 produced**.

**Where exactly it is stuck**
- At the very first operation: job card **JC-2026-00321 "Laser Cut Blank"** on **LASER-01 (Trumpf TruLaser 3030)**. Planned start 2026-08-15, never started — waiting **47 days**.
- The two later operations (JC-2026-00322 CNC Mill Housing Pocket on CNC-01, JC-2026-00323 Drill & Tap M8 on CNC-02) are also open at zero quantity — they cannot begin until the blank is laser-cut.

**Why (blocking)**
- **Three pending engineering changes** are flagged as blocking, with no resolution dates recorded: **ECO-2026-00088** (draft, "switch to new"), **ECO-2026-00023** (submitted, "continue old"), and **ECO-2026-00001** (submitted, high priority, "scrap and restart" — battery tray bend radius change, Bharat EV drg. rev C). These need a person in engineering to action them; I have no escalate tool on this seat, so I could not raise an escalation — please contact engineering directly.

**Contributing**
- Operation not started past its planned start (WO and JC-2026-00321).
- Recorded downtime on the route: LASER-01 had 300.62 min planned maintenance (recorded May 2025, over a year old); CNC-02 Haas VF-2 has 473.99 min over 2 entries since 2026-07-03 (power failure + planned maintenance).

**What it blocks**
- No sales order is linked ("none linked: no sales order on this order or its dependants"), so no direct customer exposure.
- BOM matching shows four downstream orders that **may be affected** (potential consumers of the housing blank, not confirmed blocks): WO-2026-00077 (120 pcs, high), WO-2026-00092 (60 pcs, urgent), WO-2026-00062 (50 pcs, in progress), WO-2026-00107 (10 pcs, draft) — all Motor Controller Housing Assembly.

**Rescheduling** — not requested; nothing changed. Say the word and I can run a reschedule proposal.

**Not visible to me** — nothing material; all relevant records were visible. No cost has been recorded on this WO (expected and actual both 0), so no variance can be computed.
